title: Welcome the newest member of the #ieeepdn family: IEEE Computer Society
excerpt: The IEEE Computer Society Student Branch Chapter is now live under the IEEE Student Branch of the University of Peradeniya — opening doors to endless opportunities in tech innovation and excellence.
content:
The IEEE Computer Society Student Branch Chapter is now live under the IEEE Student Branch of the University of Peradeniya, opening doors to endless opportunities in tech innovation and excellence!

Join us on this incredible journey and stay tuned for exciting updates on how you can get involved.
